assets.name: graduation-still-life
assets.use: Homepage graduation banner with live CardThumb
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photograph for an Arabic RTL graduation invitation banner; no UI in the image. Primary request: premium, believable still-life photography of a charcoal black graduation mortarboard with a simple ivory tassel and a rolled ivory diploma tied with a muted brick-red cotton ribbon. Scene: warm ivory paper backdrop #F2EAD9 with one uncoated deep red envelope #BC4749, tiny brushed brass clip as a gold #C7A661 detail. Composition: landscape 3:2, overhead to slightly angled view, objects clustered left and lower left; reserve the rightmost third as calm ivory negative space for a live editable invitation card to be layered in HTML. Lighting: genuine warm afternoon window light, soft long directional shadows, gentle analog photographic grain. Materials must be physically credible, visible paper fibers, creased cotton ribbon, matte fabric cap, imperfect edges. High-end stationery editorial, restrained and tactile. No people, no hands, no lettering, no diploma printing, no logos, no watermarks, no sparkles, no floating objects, no 3D render aesthetic, no fake bokeh, no extra clutter. Deliver a finished website photo in landscape composition.
